elements.label: 'more from CRM.' replacing 'Attio'
elements.change_other: instant word swap on a single frame

pattern.description: The 'Ask Attio' lockup drifts up slightly, then on one frame 'Attio' is swapped for 'more from CRM.'; the reflowed line ('Ask more from CRM.') is re-centred and continues a small upward settle.
pattern.why_premium: A hard word swap on the beat inside a continuous upward drift turns the brand name into the tagline; keeping 'Ask' as the fixed anchor makes the wordplay legible instantly.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to(line, {y: -8, duration: 0.3, ease: 'none'}).set(word, {textContent: 'more from CRM.'}).fromTo(line, {y: -8}, {y: -14, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out'}) with the row centred via flex so 'Ask' shifts left on the swap.
build_hint.remotion: Choose the tail string by frame (frame < swapFrame ? 'Attio' : 'more from CRM.') in a centred flex row; translateY = interpolate(frame, [start, end], [0, -14], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad)}); no spring.

notes: The swap happens between frames 1228 and 1229 (energy spike, then a zero-energy duplicate frame). 'Ask' jumps left on the reflow rather than gliding. Old 'Attio' occupied the same region as b01, so it is not listed separately.
